newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates' press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Dubai-bound Emirates airlines Airbus aircraft was found to have a damaged tail fin shortly before it was due to take off from a Paris airport last week, Emirates says.
- The Dubai police have arrested three Bangladeshis on charges of murdering a trader in a Deira jewellery shop, CID sources say.
- The Fujairah Free Zone has started its second phase of expansion. The upgrade will cost 40 million dirhams.
- Saudi Arabia has formed a team of 300 chemists to conduct research into its oil and gas reserves.
- Bahrain-based Arab Shipbuilding and Repair Yard is to invest $6.2 million in increasing berth space.
- UAE's non-oil trade with France reached 3.4 billion dirhams in 1996.
- Iraq expects to resume oil exports within two weeks.
- UAE youth team leaves Gaza to Egypt today.
